I'm not worried about the game being 1:1 because Nintendo famously hid the depths from Tears of the Kingdom launch media. If they are capable of doing that, then no doubt they've done it here. We've already seen that there's new areas in Hyrule field, bombable walls in the Water temple, a pictobox shop in castle town, and more. Keep in mind they neglected to show the Ice cavern and any grotto entirely.
